CommunityApplications.Profile:
B+ Ark Server Controller provides an Unraid web interface for managing one or more ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated-server profiles. It uses one shared ARK installation while keeping each profile's configuration, saves, logs, maps, backups and settings separate.
Install the controller container, then open its WebUI to install ARK files and create server profiles. ASA servers remain stopped until you start them from the controller.
Support: https://discord.gg/6qDKS5Z5S5
